pages.title: What It Gives
pages.text:
Permanence, and hands that are not yours.

The only path that answers whether this will still be here tomorrow - and the only one that does not answer alone. It wins nothing. It refuses to lose.

pages.title: Your First Hour
pages.text:
1. A book of binding, and a circle to bind in. The first thing you call up is the one that carries for you.
2. A brazier where the house will be. Souls keep the hearth.
3. The dead do not leave. Neither do the bound. That is the point of a household.
4. Build the room that matters before you build the wall around it.
